text:
clara_pm: quick sync — aiming to pick a default upgrade lane for private deploys that preserves customer egress IPs. goal: recommend approach by EOW.

ian_eng: main options: in-place operator, blue/green with routing handoff, and blue/green + forwarder backstop. in-place is simplest but won't keep IPs.

zoe_netops: customers with permit-lists require identical source IPs during cutover. BGP session stability is also a hard constraint for some.

harry_sales: ACME/HealthSys flagged as must-support. they'll pay for a premium SLA.

clara_pm: proposal: default = blue/green w/ routing handoff. backstop = ephemeral forwarder (proxy/NAT) to preserve outbound IP during cutover when route updates can't be done quickly.

ian_eng: PoC plan: 2-week spike for forwarder (DaemonSet + mapping controller), then operator hook for routing handoff (3 sprints).

zoe_netops: caveats: SNAT fallback breaks permit lists — need opt-in and customer-signed acceptance. require KMS-backed mapping keys and audit logs.

maya_cs: add acceptance criteria: supported topologies, dry-run mode, runbook for customer netops, clear limitations doc.

ops_bot: reminder — private-deploy v0.9 canary this Wed; tag @ian_eng if you need infra to test.

clara_pm: actions: clara draft tradeoffs + SLAs (Thu), ian start spike (demo in 2w), zoe produce network matrix (Wed), maya draft runbook (Thu).
